housing.summary: Numbeo reported an August 2026 average of EUR 868.33 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Verona city centre; Immobiliare.it carries Verona apartment listings; the deposit norm was not grounded.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity card, driving licence, or passport plus an Italian tax code or health card.
required_docs: Valid identity card, driving licence, or passport
Italian tax code or valid health card

schools.summary: The International School of Verona states that its international examinations culminate in the IB Diploma and identifies itself as IB World School 004476.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer establishing habitual residence in Verona must submit the ministerial Declaration of Residence with the required identity, occupancy, and, for non-Italians, stay-status documents to the Comune di Verona.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the completed and signed Declaration of Residence with required supporting documents to the Comune di Verona.

tax_finance.summary: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. First-time foreign applicants in Italy must book an in-person appointment; depending on status it is assigned by the Immigration Desk, police headquarters, or requested from an Italian Revenue Agency office.

transport.summary: ATV operates the Verona urban public-transport network; the standard monthly City Mover pass costs EUR 43.00. Driving-licence exchange and public-healthcare registration were left ungrounded in this record.
